taskRecords.title: Task 1 - Enemy pathfinding
taskRecords.brief: Once a tunnel connects an enemy to the player, take the shortest route through cleared cells using breadth-first search.
taskRecords.change: Changed queue.pop() to queue.popleft() in bfs_path.
taskRecords.check: The controlled map now returns the 8-step route instead of the original 10-step route.

taskRecords.title: Task 2 - Dirt colors
taskRecords.brief: Implement dirt_color(row) so each depth band has a distinct RGB color.
taskRecords.change: Added four color bands for rows 1-3, 4-6, 7-9, and 10-13.
taskRecords.check: Verified RGB values and color changes at each band boundary.

taskRecords.title: Task 3 - Enemy pop effect
taskRecords.brief: Implement on_enemy_popped(enemy, score) with an interesting effect after the fourth pump stage.
taskRecords.change: Awarded an extra 50 points for each four rows of depth and applied the returned score in pump().
taskRecords.check: A row-8 pop removes the enemy and awards 500 points total.

taskRecords.title: Task 4 - Level speed
taskRecords.brief: Implement enemy_speed_multiplier(level) so enemies move more often on later levels.
taskRecords.change: Kept level 1 at 1x and added 0.1x speed per later level.
taskRecords.check: Verified level 3 is 1.2x and uses a 0.35 / 1.2 second step delay.
